title: Villagers in Sorada protest minister over flood relief delay
seoTitle: Sorada villagers protest flood relief delay

tea.why: Villagers are angry over delayed government relief, lack of food, and slow restoration of essential services following cyclone Arnab's floods.
tea.want: Timely distribution of relief materials, restoration of power and water, and clearance of accumulated water.
tea.changed: Oct 31: Minister Gokulananda Mallik faced protests in Nuagada village within the Sorada block over delayed grain distribution.

summary: In Sorada block and surrounding areas of Odisha's Ganjam district, villagers staged protests against visiting government ministers and legislators over perceived delays in flood relief distribution. The floods were triggered by heavy rains from cyclone 'Arnab' which made landfall in neighboring Andhra Pradesh. Fisheries and Animal Resource Development Minister Gokulananda Mallik faced protests in Nuagada village within Sorada block, where residents alleged they had not received government grain relief. The minister instructed local officials to make necessary arrangements and stated that power and water issues would be sorted out soon. Similar demonstrations and confrontations involving elected officials took place in other parts of the district, with residents raising slogans, gheraoing vehicles, and demanding effective administrative intervention and timely assistance.
demands: Restoration of power supply and water connections
response: According to reports, Minister Gokulananda Mallik asked local officials to arrange assistance and stated that issues would be resolved soon. Other targeted lawmakers left the areas after security and supporters intervened, while officials engaged in relief assessments.

updates.text: Minister Gokulananda Mallik faced protests from villagers in Nuagada, Sorada block, over delayed grain relief.
